## Solution

**Setup.** Identify the plane with $\mathbb{C}$. The heptagon vertices are
$$A_k = r_7\,\omega_7^{k-1}, \quad r_7 = 6^{1/91},\ \omega_7 = e^{2\pi i/7},\ k=1,\dots,7,$$
so $A_k^7 = r_7^7 = 6^{7/91} = 6^{1/13}$. Thus the $A_k$ are the roots of
$$P(z) = z^7 - 6^{1/13}.$$

The triskaidecagon vertices are
$$B_l = i\,r_{13}\,\omega_{13}^{l-1}, \quad r_{13} = 41^{1/91},\ \omega_{13}=e^{2\pi i/13},\ l=1,\dots,13,$$
so $B_l^{13} = i^{13}\,r_{13}^{13} = i\cdot 41^{13/91} = i\cdot 41^{1/7}$. Thus the $B_l$ are the roots of
$$Q(z) = z^{13} - i\cdot 41^{1/7}.$$

**Key product.** We want $\prod_{k=1}^{7}\prod_{l=1}^{13}|A_k - B_l|$. Since this is a product of moduli,
$$\prod_{k,l}|A_k-B_l| = \left|\prod_{k,l}(A_k - B_l)\right|.$$

**Evaluating $\prod_{k,l}(B_l - A_k)$.** For each $l$,
$$\prod_{k=1}^{7}(B_l - A_k) = P(B_l) = B_l^7 - 6^{1/13}.$$
Hence
$$\prod_{l=1}^{13}\prod_{k=1}^{7}(B_l-A_k) = \prod_{l=1}^{13}\bigl(B_l^7 - 6^{1/13}\bigr).$$

Now $B_l^7 = (i\,r_{13})^7\,\omega_{13}^{7(l-1)}$. Since $\gcd(7,13)=1$, as $l$ ranges over $1,\dots,13$ the factor $\omega_{13}^{7(l-1)}$ runs through **all** 13th roots of unity. Therefore the values $B_l^7$ are precisely the 13 roots of
$$w^{13} = (i\,r_{13})^{91} = i^{91}\cdot r_{13}^{91} = (-i)\cdot 41 = -41i,$$
i.e. the roots of $w^{13}+41i = 0$.

For a monic polynomial $w^{13}+41i$ with roots $w_1,\dots,w_{13}$,
$$\prod_{l=1}^{13}(w_l - c) = (-1)^{13}\prod_{l=1}^{13}(c-w_l) = -\bigl(c^{13}+41i\bigr).$$
Setting $c = 6^{1/13}$ (so $c^{13}=6$):
$$\prod_{l=1}^{13}\bigl(B_l^7 - 6^{1/13}\bigr) = -(6+41i).$$

**Concluding.** Since $(-1)^{91} = -1$,
$$\prod_{k,l}(A_k - B_l) = (-1)^{91}\prod_{k,l}(B_l-A_k) = -\bigl(-(6+41i)\bigr) = 6+41i.$$
Therefore
$$\prod_{k=1}^{7}\prod_{l=1}^{13}|A_k - B_l| = |6+41i| = \sqrt{6^2+41^2} = \sqrt{36+1681} = \sqrt{1717}.$$

Since $1717 = 17\times 101$ is square-free, the product of all $91$ lengths is

$$\boxed{\sqrt{1717}}.$$
